study_role.non_substitution: No pixel-track result, positive or negative, substitutes for any of the four prespecified six-task primary intervals in matched_objective_protocol.json.
study_role.comparison: paper-derived Dreamer-4 Equation-(7)-style shortcut forcing versus trajectory iMF in the same compact recurrent world model

base_model_contract.shared_initialization: identical initialization seed; all same-shaped shared trunk tensors must be bit-identical before training
base_model_contract.objective_rng_pairing: one retained per-update JAX key schedule shared by arm

environment.continuation_aggregation: product of native discounts over executed native steps
environment.terminal_repeat_rule: stop the repeat loop immediately after the first LAST time step
environment.reset_action: all-zero normalized action aligned with the reset observation
environment.reset_frame_stack: repeat the first rendered frame exactly frame_stack times

rendering.render_point: after reset and after the final executed native step of each repeated action

observation.downsampling: non-overlapping integer 2x2 area mean with round-half-up in uint arithmetic

evaluation.window_rule: uniform without replacement from held-out windows whose context and complete 60-step suffix lie in one episode

metrics.normalized_visual_mse: mean over newest-frame RGB pixels and predictive draws of squared error divided per channel by training-pixel variance clipped below 0.0004
metrics.predictive_mean_psnr_db: 10*log10(1/MSE) after clipping the predictive mean and target to [0,1]
metrics.predictive_mean_global_ssim: per-image RGB global SSIM with C1=0.0001 and C2=0.0009, then arithmetic mean over windows
metrics.energy_score: mean normalized pixel L2 distance from predictive draws to target minus half the mean normalized distance between all ordered distinct draw pairs
metrics.temporal_difference_mse: MSE between predicted and true newest-frame changes across successive registered horizons
metrics.auc: normalized trapezoidal AUC of normalized_visual_mse over registered horizons

evaluation.raw_retention: targets, context, future actions, posterior keys, base noise, every arm/NFE prediction at registered horizons, and per-window metrics

analysis.aggregation: interquartile mean with exact symmetric 25 percent fractional trimming over the 3 task by 5 seed matrix
analysis.uncertainty: paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap resampling tasks and then seeds within each sampled task
analysis.multiplicity_role: descriptive secondary interval; it cannot enter or alter the primary four-interval family

compute.equal_updates: both arms receive the frozen reference update count
compute.equal_compiler_flops: shortcut receives the frozen reference count; trajectory receives floor(reference_count*shortcut_train_flops/trajectory_train_flops), at least one
compute.compiler_measure: XLA cost_analysis FLOPs for a full jitted forward-and-backward Adam world-model update
compute.inference_measure: retain raw XLA cost_analysis for the complete transition and a structural NFE-adjusted value equal to one-NFE transition FLOPs plus (NFE-1) times separately compiled prior-field FLOPs; this avoids treating loop-body-once XLA accounting as multi-NFE cost

hard.cuda_visible_devices: one nonempty selector other than -1 or NoDevFiles, with no comma

smoke.evidence_label: real-render engineering smoke; never scientific evidence

randomness.derivation: SHA-256 domain-separated uint32 pairs for JAX; SHA-256 domain-separated uint64 for NumPy
randomness.environment_seed_formula: uint64_big_endian(SHA256(canonical_json(['pixel-benchmark', domain, task, registered_seed])) first 8 bytes) modulo (2^32-1)
